preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The integer k is between 1 and 26 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'impossible' if len(set(s)) < k and len(s) < k else isinstance(return_value, int)
postconditions.description: The output is 'impossible' if the number of different letters in s is less than k and the length of s is less than k; otherwise, the output is an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if len(set(s)) >= k else return_value > 0
postconditions.description: The output is 0 if the number of different letters in s is already at least k; otherwise, the output is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len(s) - len(set(s)) + (k - len(set(s))) if len(set(s)) < k and len(s) >= k else True
postconditions.description: If the number of different letters in s is less than k and the length of s is at least k, the output is the number of changes needed to make at least k different letters; otherwise, this condition is not applicable.
